steps.title: Как это работает
steps.html:
My sister’s cleverer than me.

Short adjective → -er + than. than is weak here: it sounds like  th’n.

steps.title: Как это работает
steps.html:
My brother isn’t as confident as my sister.

as … as = the same amount. With not, it means less.

steps.title: Как это работает
steps.html:
I’m taller than my parents.

One syllable → -er. Never more tall.
